verdict.rationale: Fly.io's regions reference says apps can be deployed in regions worldwide, with users routed to the nearest server over a global Anycast network. Its docs also describe Machines that run close to users and deploying to multiple regions with a single command. A Fly staff reply about a host in the syd region independently confirms that workloads run in specific named regions. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how to select or pin specific regions (e.g., region flags or config), and hands-on independent corroboration of the region-targeting workflow.
